## Environment info
<!-- Please include some relevant information about your environment. -->
<!-- For "Backend", please indicate the backup destination (e.g. Amazon S3, OneDrive, FTP, WebDAV, local). -->
- **Duplicati version**: 2.0.4.16
- **Operating system**: All
- **Backend**: All

## Description
It appears that with version 2.0.4.16, not all index files are uploaded in an initial backup.  Version 2.0.4.15 does not exhibit this behavior.  I suspect that this may be related to the new parallel upload code.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix index files not being created for full dblock files
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix index files not being created for full dblock files

As part of the parallel upload changes a bug slipped in where a check was
being made if the index volume writer exists before creating said index
volume writer to actually create the index file. Fixed by changing the
test to check if the temporary index volume exists and then creating
the writer for the index file.

Fixes #3703
